models.notes: Cache hit pricing is 0.1x base input ($0.50/MTok); 5-minute cache write is 1.25x base ($6.25/MTok); 1-hour cache write is 2x ($10/MTok). Batch API discounts both input and output by 50%. Knowledge cutoff Jan 2026. Uses a new tokenizer vs prior Claude models (may use up to 35% more tokens for identical text). Cache hit pricing is 0.1x base input ($0.30/MTok); 5-minute cache write is 1.25x base ($3.75/MTok); 1-hour cache write is 2x ($6/MTok). Batch API discounts both input and output by 50%. Reasoning model with adjustable reasoning_effort; reasoning tokens are billed at the output rate. Context window 400k, max output 128k confirmed against developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5 (previous row had max_output_tokens as low-confidence). Cached input at 10% of base ($0.125/MTok). Batch API at flat 50% off input and output. PDF input via the Files API; image input native; audio is NOT supported on this model_id. Knowledge cutoff Sept 2024. Not on the April 2026 deprecation list.

Input pricing shown is for prompts <=200k tokens; prompts >200k tokens are billed per pricing_tiers. Cache hit rate also tiers at 200k: $0.125/MTok <=200k, $0.25/MTok >200k (schema captures only the <=200k rate in cache_read_per_mtok_usd). Context window and max_output_tokens confirmed via ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-2.5-pro. Thinking is always on and cannot be disabled; thinking tokens are billed at the output rate. Knowledge cutoff January 2025. Batch Mode discount is a flat 50% off input/output. Explicit context caching storage is billed at $4.50 per MTok-stored per hour (not captured in cache_write_per_mtok_usd since the schema's per-Mtok rate cannot express the hourly storage dimension). Free tier (AI Studio) is published as per-minute RPM/TPM only, not per-day; free_tier omitted. PDF input via the Files API; image, audio, and video native.
